title: Mixed Event — One Small Trip Before a Big Journey — Episode1 My Last Field Trip?

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls first years are headed to Yokohama! Haruka realizes this field trip might be her last memory with her general education class before returning to the credit-based course. Saki asks to be in her group for the trip.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright class, I will now go over the schedule for our upcoming field trip.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We will be meeting up at Kannai Station at 9 a.m. and heading over to the History Archive Museum from there. You will then have free time starting at 12 p.m.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: In a short moment, I would like you all to form groups of five for the day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow! Yokohama!
It's gonna be so hard to decide where to go during free time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If we're going to Yokohama, then the Chinatown over there is an option. But I'm sure there are plenty of other places to go too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Definitely! Oh, I wanna try those steamed buns or sesame balls!
Minato Mirai seems super pretty too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait to take loads of photos with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (A field trip...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Since switching to the general education course, I've been able to experience so many events. The Sports Festival, the School Festival, and even the Seaside School...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm also switching back to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because it's the best way for us to spread hope to as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It won't be long until I'm back to being in the credit-based course.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (So this might be the last time I get to participate in an event like this...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright then, Hoshino. As class representative, will you do the honors?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course. Understood.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Without further ado, please form groups of five.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For this field trip, you will be spending the allocated free time in your groups. Each group will need to submit their itinerary for the day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Please submit your itinerary once you have a plan, preferably during homeroom time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Roger dodger, Class Rep!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can find the itinerary template sheets and some guidebooks at the front. Feel free to pick those up once you have formed your groups.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Please keep to a total of five members per group. You may now start!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, who should I form a group with...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, Ichi! Wanna form a group together?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
W-Wait, was I too late?!
Do you already have a group?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, not yet. If you don't mind, I'd like to be in a group with you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's all have a fun time, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I'm looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if we're forming groups of five, we'll need two more people, right? Who else should we invite?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I've got that covered! I have candidates!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If you're okay with it, can I invite two girls from the soft tennis club? That would bring us to five in total!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. I'm fine with that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. Thanks, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Alright, I'll go ask them now. Be right back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait!
They didn't have a group yet, so we're all set to be a group of five!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Please meet my friends from the soft tennis club, Sono and Ino!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for the introduction, but we already know each other, remember?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looking forward to spending the day with you two.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Yeah! Looking forward to it, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: I can't believe I get to be in the same group as Kiritani. It's like I'm dreaming. Let's all have lots of fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well then, shall we start planning? I'll grab a template sheet and a guidebook.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okie dokie! Thanks, Ichi!
I guess we can use some of these desks over here.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Sounds good. Let's push these desks together!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa! Be careful!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Hehe.
Looks like it's going to be a lively trip.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! Let's put our heads together and plan a fun itinerary!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
